Title: Solutions for Moving the Car Farther
Rows: Form openings on the top of the bottle so the gas escapes from the top instead of the back.
Add more baking soda and citric acid so more gas is generated inside the bottle.
Secure the stopper to the back of the bottle with a piece of tape so gas pressure increases.
Remove the stopper from the back of the bottle so the gas produced can escape more easily.
